Package hadur2.core.knn

package hadur2.core.knn
K-nearest-neighbour learning shared by the duel's gun and movement: a weighted KD-tree and the views built on it.
  • KdTree: a weighted squared-Euclidean KD-tree ported from Diamond's, with a FIFO size limit that evicts the oldest point (RES-2).
  • DistanceFormula: turns a wave into a feature point and holds each feature's weight. The gun's and the surf's formulas live in their own packages.
  • KnnView: one formula, one bounded tree and the settings that say which waves it learns from, how many neighbours it returns (scaled down while the tick budget is short, TIME-1 and TIME-2) and when the surf switches it on. It also takes the samples an opponent profile replays, at their shared seed weight (ADAPT-3), and stops counting them once that weight has faded to zero (RES-4).

A view is a store and a search, not a strategy: the gun and the surf decide what to log and how to turn neighbours into an aim or a danger. Every view is bounded, by its own cap or by KnnView.DEFAULT_MAX_DATA_POINTS (RES-2). Search results depend only on the points and the order they went in, never on a clock or randomness (CORE-2, RES-6).

Dependencies: this package uses only the model (waves, timestamps, seed weights), the physics helpers and the JDK (CORE-1). The architecture tests forbid it to depend on memory, adapt, policy, melee or posture, and physics may not depend on it. It is one of the duel packages that DuelIdentityTest pins.
